correctness.rationale: The strict Dulac inequality follows exactly from (x+b)^2>=4bx and the -r/(ky) term; the equality cutoff is included. Below cutoff, explicit choices k>3b, small r>0 and d=ea/2-sigma*2rb(k-b)/(ak)>0 yield a unique positive hyperbolic repeller, positive invasion exponent at (k,0), bounded forward orbits and no boundary-return saddle graph; Poincare-Bendixson forces an interior cycle. The exact rational witness has trace 19/30000 and determinant 2233/1875000. The bundled checker recomputes the key algebra.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the exact sharp competition coefficient excluding all positive periodic orbits uniformly in four other ecological parameters, including the delicate equality case; for every smaller coefficient, a concrete open family has an interior cycle. This directly quantifies robustness against oscillation and is not merely a local Jacobian or standard Bendixson exercise alone.
